<!--
  The top of a page: heading, lead and actions, with optional media (image, backdrop, code window, cluster).
  Axes: layout, media kind and side, scale, tone, density, actions mode.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { HeroMedia } from "./hero-classic.types";
import type { ActionSet } from "../components/cta-actions.types";
import type { CodeLine } from "../components/code-window.types";
import type { Topic } from "../components/topic-chips.types";

export type HeroClassicProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  text: string;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  badge?: string;
  topics?: Topic[];
  actions?: ActionSet;
  media?: HeroMedia;
  layout?: "centered" | "split";
  scale?: "default" | "display";
  tone?: "default" | "muted" | "inverse";
  density?: "roomy" | "default" | "compact";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import Button from "../primitives/button/button.vue";
import Grid from "../primitives/grid/grid.vue";
import Group from "../primitives/group/group.vue";
import Input from "../primitives/input/input.vue";
import Label from "../primitives/label/label.vue";
import ActionGroup from "../components/action-group.vue";
import Backdrop from "../components/backdrop.vue";
import CodeWindow from "../components/code-window.vue";
import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.vue";
import SectionFrame from "../components/section-frame.vue";
import TopicChips from "../components/topic-chips.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  text,
  level = 1,
  badge,
  topics,
  actions,
  media,
  layout = "centered",
  scale = "default",
  tone = "default",
  density = "roomy",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<HeroClassicProps>();
const mediaKind = computed(() => media?.kind ?? "none");
const mediaSide = computed(() => media?.side ?? "end");
</script>

<template>
  <SectionFrame
    :id="id"
    :title="title"
    :lead="text"
    :heading="{ level, scale, badge }"
    :layout="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'split' : 'stack')"
    :align="(((layout as string) === 'split') ? 'start' : 'center')"
    :media="{
      show: (((mediaKind as string) === 'image') || ((mediaKind as string) === 'code') || ((mediaKind as string) === 'cluster')),
      side: mediaSide,
    }"
    :tone="tone"
    :density="density"
    :class="
      (((mediaKind as string) === 'backdrop') ? 'image' : 'none') === 'image' ? 'relative isolate overflow-hidden'
      : ''
    "
    :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Backdrop :kind="(((mediaKind as string) === 'backdrop') ? 'image' : 'none')" :alt="title" />
    <template v-if="actions?.cta">
      <Box v-if="(actions?.mode === 'form')"
        :class="cn('w-full max-w-xl', (((layout as string) === 'centered') ? 'mx-auto' : ''))"
        data-testid="email-form"
      >
        <Label :for="tpl('{0}-email', id)" class="sr-only">
          {{ actions?.emailLabel }}
        </Label>
        <Group gap="2" align="start" class="w-full flex-wrap">
          <Input
            type="text"
            name="prompt"
            class="min-w-0 flex-1"
            :placeholder="actions?.emailLabel"
            :id="tpl('{0}-email', id)"
            data-testid="field"
          />
          <Button variant="default" size="default" :href="(actions?.href ?? '#/')" data-testid="submit">
            {{ actions?.cta }}
          </Button>
        </Group>
      </Box>
      <ActionGroup v-else
        :primary="actions?.cta"
        :primaryHref="actions?.href"
        :secondary="((actions?.mode === 'two') ? actions?.secondary : undefined)"
        :secondaryHref="actions?.secondaryHref"
        :align="(((layout as string) === 'centered') ? 'center' : 'start')"
      />
    </template>
    <TopicChips v-if="topics" :topics="topics" />
    <template #aside>
      <CodeWindow
        v-if="(((mediaKind as string) === 'code') && media?.lines && media?.codeTitle && media?.prompt)"
        :title="media?.codeTitle"
        :prompt="media?.prompt"
        :lines="media?.lines"
      />
      <Grid v-if="((mediaKind as string) === 'cluster')" cols="3" class="items-end gap-4" data-testid="cluster">
        <Box :class="cn('w-full', '')">
          <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
        </Box>
        <Box :class="cn('w-full', '-translate-y-4')">
          <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
        </Box>
        <Box :class="cn('w-full', '')">
          <MediaFrame :alt="title" ratio="3/4" />
        </Box>
      </Grid>
      <MediaFrame v-if="(((mediaKind as string) === 'image'))" :alt="title" ratio="4/3" />
    </template>
  </SectionFrame>
</template>
